name: Fahd APC
armament: 1-3 x 7.62 mm PK MGs on roof mounts (Fahd 240)
280-30: BMP-2 turret with 30 mm 2A42 and ATGM
protection: All-welded steel resisting 7.62 mm AP and fragments. Game rule: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and 12.7/14.5 mm can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Large box-shaped 4x4 hull on a Mercedes-Benz truck chassis, Fuchs-like look
Driver and commander front windows with armoured shutters
Rear door with fold-down step, roof hatches
4 firing ports with vision blocks per side
